name: tathkara
description: Event ticketing with a live seat map — React + Node.js (Fastify) monorepo.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @tathkara/api & npm run dev -w @tathkara/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tathkara/shared && npm run build -w @tathkara/web && npm run build -w @tathkara/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tathkara/api && npm run test -w @tathkara/web
